Name: Archireef
Description:
Archireef is a nature-tech company helping coastal developers, port operators, and infrastructure owners understand, manage, and demonstrate their marine biodiversity performance.

We provide end-to-end services across four integrated layers: ecological risk and opportunity assessment, proprietary eco-engineering deployment, AI-enabled long-term monitoring, and regulatory-grade reporting aligned with IFC PS6, TNFD, and the Equator Principles.

Our proprietary products — Reef Tiles and Eco-Seawall Panels — are manufactured from biocompatible terracotta using adaptive 3D-printing processes. Biomimetically designed and diver-deployed, they deliver measurable marine biodiversity uplift across seabed, seawall, and breakwater environments with no heavy machinery required.

Every deployment is paired with a structured monitoring programme using eDNA analysis, AI-enabled photogrammetry, and bioindicator protocols — producing decision-useful evidence for clients, lenders, and regulators.

To date, we have conserved and restored approximately 77,000 m2 of critical marine habitats across Hong Kong, Singapore, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, with observed species abundance increases of up to ~7× at monitored sites over 12 months.

Founded in 2020 in Hong Kong. Operations headquartered in the UAE. Serving clients across the GCC and Asia-Pacific.
Location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates

By combining advanced microalgae biotechnology, photobioreactor engineering, IoT-based monitoring, and real-time environmental data, Carbelim enables measurable air quality improvement, carbon capture, oxygen generation, and ESG-aligned sustainability outcomes.

Our solutions are designed for the future of urban infrastructure, where sustainability must be visible, measurable, scalable, and integrated into everyday environments. From AirForestTM systems and PureAir TowersTM to smart benches, indoor air purification units, and environmental intelligence platforms, Carbelim creates living systems that support cleaner air and carbon-neutral growth.

At the core of Carbelim’s work is a simple vision: to build breathable, resilient, carbon-neutral cities by turning infrastructure into living climate infrastructure.

Carbelim is committed to advancing biological air purification, carbon capture and utilisation, smart city sustainability, ESG innovation, and nature-inspired engineering for a cleaner and healthier future.

Name: Eureka Agriculture Consultants Abu Dhabi | EACAD
Description:
Eureka Agriculture Consultants Abu Dhabi (EACAD)

At Eureka Agriculture Consultants Abu Dhabi, our philosophy in date palm tissue culture technology stands apart from conventional commercial practices.

We are not driven by the pursuit of rapid profit or market expansion- those belong to the realm of sales and marketing.

Our mission is singular and uncompromising: to produce the highest-quality propagules and tissue-culture plantlets in the world.

True innovation requires courage, the courage to prioritize quality over quantity, and biological integrity over commercial expediency.

At EACAD, we uphold the twelve-generation cap on clonal multiplication, a principle that safeguards genetic stability, vitality, and authenticity of each cultivar.

This discipline reflects our deep respect for Phoenix dactylifera—a species that sustains both ecosystems and civilizations.

We do not merely propagate plants.
We preserve lineage, safeguard biodiversity, and extend the legacy of one of humanity’s most enduring crops.
That is what defines our work, and what makes EACAD’s Special OrganogenesisTM micropropagation system a global benchmark in scientific precision, sustainability, and ethical biotechnology.

Beyond tissue culture, EACAD provides comprehensive agricultural consultancy services - from farm design, soil and water management, and fertigation systems to integrated pest management, post-harvest solutions, and genetic resource preservation.

However, our core specialization remains the complete A - Z of tissue culture technology, with unmatched expertise in Phoenix dactylifera L. the date palm species that defines our scientific identity and legacy.

Dr. S. E. A. Zaid  |  Asst. Prof. 
Founder & Principle Consultant
